name: buzz-or-lose-arena
description: BUZZ OR LOSE – THE ARENA: live tournament game-show platform

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.render-build: npm ci --prefix server --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
